sourceChanges: SDK-restored sessions are revalidated against exact eip155:6423, the single approved lowercase 0x account, supported methods and supported events before display or use
incoming JSON-RPC requests require the method to have been approved by the matching restored Reown session, not merely supported globally
wallet_addEthereumChain and wallet_switchEthereumChain parse one structural params object and reject substring-based 0x1917 spoofing, widened keys, foreign RPC URLs and invalid YNXT metadata
invalid incoming requests are answered immediately with bounded EIP-1193-compatible errors 4100, 4200, 4901 or -32602 and never enter the approval UI
no project ID, signer, account, private key, transaction target or production authority is embedded

webExtension.boundary: The injected browser provider is a distinct YNX EIP-1193 provider. It must not pretend to be MetaMask or claim WalletConnect relay authority.

validation.localSwiftPMBlocker: CommandLineTools SwiftBuild fails before compilation because Apple platform xcspec definitions are registered twice; no full-Xcode developer directory exists on this host
validation.hostedCINote: Existing wallet-macos and wallet-ios push workflows are branch-scoped to main and the Apple owner branch. This independent successor branch did not widen workflow triggers or dispatch CI.

singleExecutableBlocker.summary: Source plumbing exists and is default-off, but real relay interoperability cannot execute without a protected Reown project binding, signed persistence identity, approved test account through the existing signer, bounded test transaction policy and eligible installed targets.
singleExecutableBlocker.requiredAction: A named Central release owner must issue one path-scoped native WalletConnect execution lease and inject the already-frozen protected values into an eligible signed iOS/macOS or Android test build. Values must remain outside chat, evidence and git.
requiredProtectedInputs: real Reown project ID and relay allowlist receipt
signing-authorized Apple app group/keychain identity or Android secure persistence identity
approved Testnet 0x account bound through the existing native signer; never a raw private key
exact first-party, Uniswap, OpenSea and Safe execution URLs
named immediate confirmations for approve, reject, sign, EIP-712, send and disconnect/revoke

promotionRule: This checkpoint proves source hardening and platform inventory only. It cannot promote relay, installed, public, account, signature, transaction, external-DApp or product completion gates.
